seg.seg_note: Two reportable segments: MIS (CFG, SFG, FIG, PPIF, MIS Other) and MA (RD&A, ERS, PS; MAKS/Copal Amba aggregated into MA and reported in PS). All segment items (LOB revenue, intersegment royalty/revenue, segment Adjusted Operating Income, D&A, restructuring, segment operating income) from the release Table 2 / Table 6 (three-month columns). mis_recurring / mis_transaction and ma_recurring / ma_transaction = release Table 7 'Relationship' / 'Transaction' revenue (external). elim = Table 6 total eliminations (MIS royalty + MA intersegment revenue). Segment Adjusted Operating Income includes intersegment revenue and expense. us_rev / intl_rev = consolidated 'United States' / 'International' (Table 2). Bureau van Dijk (acquired 10-Aug-2017) is in MA and its revenue in the RD&A LOB; Acquisition-Related Expenses are charged entirely to MA in the segment table. FY: 10-K Note 20 agrees with the Q4 release; 'Total ratings revenue' 2,755.3 from the 10-K. MAKS no longer described as a separate operating segment in the 2017 10-K (two operating segments).
